records.question: How many orders did each customer from Pune place this year?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of year')
WHERE c.city = 'Pune'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.name
LIMIT 500;

records.question: Which customers placed orders in both September and October 2026?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, c.city, c.country
FROM customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o1 
    WHERE o1.customer_id = c.id 
      AND o1.order_date >= '2026-09-01' 
      AND o1.order_date <= '2026-09-30'
) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o2 
    WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id 
      AND o2.order_date >= '2026-10-01' 
      AND o2.order_date <= '2026-10-31'
)
ORDER BY c.name
LIMIT 500;

records.question: Which customers live in the city that has the most customers?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT name, city, country, signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE city = (
    SELECT city
    FROM customers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY city
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 500;

records.question: Show the number of orders per month for the last 6 months and the difference from the previous month.
records.generated_sql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-5 months', '-1 month')
      AND order_date < date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '+1 month')
    GROUP BY month
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        order_count,
        LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_order_count
    FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT 
    month,
    order_count,
    (order_count - prev_order_count) AS difference
FROM with_lag
WHERE month >= strftime('%Y-%m', date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-5 months'))
ORDER BY month;

records.question: How many orders were placed by customers in Chennai last month?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.city = 'Chennai'
  AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-1 month')
  AND o.order_date < date('2026-11-07', 'start of month');

records.question: Which products are priced above the average product price?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT name, category, ROUND(price, 2) AS price
FROM products
WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 500;

records.question: On average, how many orders does a customer place, counting only customers who have ordered? Round to two decimals.
records.generated_sql:
SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(o.id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 2) AS average_orders_per_customer
FROM orders AS o;

records.question: List the cancelled orders from the last 7 days with the customer name and amount.
records.generated_sql:
SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.total AS amount, o.order_date
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', '-7 days')
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.id
LIMIT 500;
